_comment: Class ceilings the build enforces over dose_ranges (pipeline/build/dose_gates.py). For a class whose members are dosed in micrograms, a ladder tier above `max_tier_mg` is a unit slip or a copied error rather than a dose, and the row is deleted unless it carries a citation or comes from an exempt source. Every deletion is listed in data/snapshots/dose-gate-report.md. Keyed by class_contexts.slug.

gates.reason: fentanyl is dosed in tens of micrograms and no anilidopiperidine in human use is more than ~100× weaker (PMID 40721041 ranks six analogs within a decade of fentanyl in vivo); a tier above 2 mg is a milligram written for a microgram
etonitazene is ~1,000× morphine and the weakest nitazenes in circulation are still morphine-range per milligram (EMCDDA nitazene risk assessments), so a tier above 2 mg is not a dose
